text_block_list.text: After finishing training, as I was tidying up the equipment we used—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san... would you let me
train just a little bit more?
choice_data_list: ...What's got into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, if you ask what's wrong,
I'd say nothing really, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, my "nothing happening" is actually
something incredibly rare and blessed."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There was also a period when I couldn't move my body for a long time.
There were so many things I wanted to do, but couldn't.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And now, she's able to run like this again,
to the point where her spirit is overflowing.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So please...
Let me keep pushing, just a little bit longer!
choice_data_list: Okay, let's do a little more!
That'll lead to overwork, so no can do.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, where should we start?
Uphill dashes? Time trials? I also
want to do strength training! And tire pulls!"
choice_data_list: That much is impossible, you know?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry!
I just got so happy, I couldn't help myself... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It feels so good to have a body that can give it its all!
I have to repay everyone who gave me this body...!"
And so, K.S. Miracle enthusiastically carried out extra training.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: You were pretty winded at the end of training, so...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You're right. Without realizing it,
the fatigue must've built up...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. As expected of you, Trainer.
You really understand my body.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
――Understood. I'll endure it.
Because I believe you're in the right, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "To make up for not being able to train today, I'll work extra hard tomorrow. ...Good night!"
And so, K.S. Miracle passed on doing extra self-training.
